user.title: Light Layers
user.description: Adds Light Layers. Then add lights to it on the integration's page (Add light); each gets a base layer and the layers you configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Light Layers is already set up; add lights on its page.

user.title: Add a light
user.description: Layers for a real light. The base layer is the light's normal state: use it like the real light. With *Take over the entity id* (recommended) the base gets the real light's entity id and its labels, and the real light becomes <id>_raw, hidden, so automations, scenes and dashboards keep working and go through the layers. Each layer is a light of its own; the real light shows the highest one that is on. More layers later under the light's Layers and settings.

data_description.name: Empty: the real light's name.
data_description.take_over: Rename the real light to <id>_raw and hide it; the base takes its id, labels, aliases and voice exposure. Undone when the helper is deleted.
data_description.layer: Optional, e.g. Door: a layer with priority 10 (more under Layers and settings).
data_description.wall_switch: Smart bulb behind an ordinary switch: when it comes back on after being unreachable, someone switched it on there, so that becomes the normal state.

add_layer.title: Add a layer
add_layer.description: A light of its own above the base. While it is on, the real light shows it (the highest priority wins); off, it lets the layers below through.

data_description.wall_switch: Smart bulb behind an ordinary switch: when it comes back on after being unreachable, someone switched it on there, so that becomes the normal state.

error.layered: That is already a layered light; pick the real light.
error.not_in_registry: This light has no unique id, so it cannot be renamed; turn off Take over the entity id.
error.duplicate: There already is a layer with that name.
